My plot is very small, only a tiny piece for maize, and I have no money to buy a whole bag of fertilizer from the cooperative — one bag is too much for this little land and costs more birr than I have. I will put the manure from my goats and the ash from my cooking fire on the soil like my mother taught me. I will use the seed I saved from last year's harvest because I know it and the rains have been poor, so I cannot risk money on new seed from the town. My husband and I will do all the work ourselves with the hoe; we have no cash to pay anyone.
